# nomatron_destroy_app_jobs (Action)

Create destroy plans for all live Nomad jobs in one Nomatron application. This stops and purges runtime state only; it does not delete Nomatron application or job resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "nomatron_destroy_app_jobs" "payments" {
  config {
    org_name = "acme"
    app_slug = "payments"

    # Queues a destroy plan for every live Nomad job in this app.
    # This does not delete Nomatron application or job resources.
    apply = false
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_slug` (String) Application slug whose live Nomad jobs should be stopped and purged.
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the application.

### Optional

- `apply` (Boolean) When true, immediately queue destroy applies for ready destroy plans. Approval-required plans still need approval before apply can be queued.
